mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0008.retrievePayrollItemUseList */ ppiu.payroll_type_code AS payroll_type_code , ppiu.payroll_type_code AS ori_payroll_type_code , cccm.common_code_name AS payroll_type_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ppiu.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ppiu.effective_end_yyyymmdd , 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ppiu.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ori_effective_start_yyyymmdd /* 변경 전 시작일. 데이터 수정시 조건으로 사용함 */ FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_use_n ppiu , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm WHERE ppiu.payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND cccm.code_type_code = ccc.code_type_code AND cccm.common_code = ccc.common_code AND ccc.common_code = ppiu.payroll_type_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ORDER BY ccc.sort_order_no

WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 Detail 항목 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAYP0008.retireveValidateData */ ppiu.payroll_type_code , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ppiu.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ppiu.effective_end_yyyymmdd , 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_use_n ppiu WHERE ppiu.payroll_item_id = #{parameter.payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ AND (ppiu.payroll_type_code, ppiu.effective_start_yyyymmdd) NOT IN SELECT #{deleted[${idx}].payrollTypeCode}, #{deleted[${idx}].oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd} FROM DUAL ) , rs AS ( SELECT #{created[${idx}].payrollTypeCode} AS payroll_type_code , #{created[${idx}].effectiveStartYyyymmdd} AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , #{created[${idx}].effectiveEndYyyymmdd} AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT NVL(update_list.payroll_type_code , detail_list.payroll_type_code) AS payroll_type_code , NVL(update_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd, detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd) AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , NVL(update_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd , detail_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd) AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Use 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Use 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT #{updated[${idx}].payrollTypeCode} AS payroll_type_code , #{updated[${idx}].oriPayrollTypeCode} AS ori_payroll_type_code , #{updated[${idx}].effectiveStartYyyymmdd} AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , #{updated[${idx}].effectiveEndYyyymmdd} AS effective_end_yyyymmdd , #{updated[${idx}].oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd} AS ori_effective_start_yyyymmdd FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.payroll_type_code = update_list.ori_payroll_type_code(+) AND detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd = update_list.ori_effective_start_yyyymmdd(+) SELECT detail_list.payroll_type_code , detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd , detail_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM detail_list ) SELECT /* payroll_type_code 중복인지 체크 */ DISTINCT listagg(ccm.common_code_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ccm.common_code_name) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_payroll_type_names ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.use' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_payroll_type_names_title FROM rs , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c ccm WHERE ccm.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND ccm.common_code = rs.payroll_type_code AND ccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND EXISTS (/* 날짜 중복인 property 조회 */ SELECT 'x' FROM rs rs0 WHERE rs0.payroll_type_code = rs.payroll_type_code /* 시작일 또는 종료일이 기간내에 포함된 경우 */ AND (rs0.effective_start_yyyymmdd BETWEEN rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd OR rs0.effective_end_yyyymmdd BETWEEN rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd) GROUP BY rs0.payroll_type_code HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) GROUP BY rs.payroll_type_code, ccm.common_code_name
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAYP0008.insertPayrollItemUse */ INTO tb_pay_payroll_item_use_n( payroll_item_id /* 급여항목아이디 */ , payroll_type_code /* 급여유형코드 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd /* 유효시작년월일 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd /* 유효종료년월일 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_item_id => 급여항목아이디 */ , #{payrollTypeCode} /* payroll_type_code => 급여유형코드 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* effective_start_yyyymmdd => 유효시작년월일 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* effective_end_yyyymmdd => 유효종료년월일 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAYP0008.updatePayrollItemUse */ tb_pay_payroll_item_use_n SET payroll_type_code = #{payrollTypeCode} /* 급여유형코드 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효시작년월일 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') /* 유효종료년월일 */ WHERE payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목아이디 */ AND payroll_type_code = #{oriPayrollTypeCode} /* 급여유형코드 */ AND effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD')
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAYP0008.deletePayrollItemUse */ FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_use_n WHERE payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목아이디 */ AND payroll_type_code = #{oriPayrollTypeCode} /* 급여유형코드 */ AND effective_start_yyyymmdd = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD')
